site_name: Titicut Brook Site 20 - Dam Lot Brook (Orchard St)

version_note: v9: citation and location from Vol. 71 No. 2

site_name: Ja-Mar Site / Nemasket River Village
bulletin_issue: American Archaeology Vol. 22 No. 4 (Winter 2018); MAS excavations 1930s-1960s
location_basis: Middle Archaic-Late Woodland occupation; Wampanoag village c. AD 1400. Pottery, chipped and ground stone, bear-effigy pestle, unfired clay balls; subdivision halted 2016-17 when burials were found. Former Ja-Mar Turkey Farm between 483 and 491 Plymouth St, ~0.7 km E of Oliver Mill Park; now conserved with a Cultural Respect Easement.

site_name: Leland Farm Site (Beaver Brook)
